subject: Support access & residency constraints — Blackridge discovery
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@blackridge.com>
Cc: security@blackridge.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Support access & residency constraints — Blackridge discovery

Alicia / Blackridge security team — thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and the clarification asks so we can put together a concise package: 

1) Residency: you mentioned data for EU customers must remain in EU regions. Please confirm (a) whether this is required for both at-rest and backups, and (b) if there are any sanctioned EU regions we should target (e.g., eu-west-1 / eu-central-1).

2) PII scope: we heard name/email and payroll identifiers may be in the payloads sent to the API. Can you confirm the complete list of sensitive fields (example: full name, email, national ID / payroll ID, financial account numbers)? If you prefer, attach a sample sanitized payload.

3) Retention: what are your retention windows for derived artifacts (embeddings, logs, transcripts)? You mentioned ~7 years for some records — please confirm per data class.

4) Support access model: please outline which Blackridge roles need support-level access (read-only vs. read+debug), and any constraints on who may be granted break-glass privileges. We discussed JIT access for short sessions and the need for full audit logs.

5) Logging & evidence: will you require audit log streaming (S3) or periodic exports? Any special encryption/KMS requirements?

Next steps from our side: we will draft an RBAC matrix, a break-glass runbook with approval flow and an architecture note showing EU-only residency + KMS controls. If that looks good, we can combine these into a short package (SOC2 summary, RBAC matrix, break-glass runbook) and share it by EOD Monday.

Attaching a short worksheet you can fill out if that helps: Blackridge-PII-request.xlsx (attachment).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@blackridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 18:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Support access & residency constraints — Blackridge discovery

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Residency: yes, all production data and backups must remain in the EU (we prefer eu-central-1). No replicas outside EU.

- PII scope: customer full name, business email, employee payroll_id (internal payroll identifier), and VAT numbers are in scope. We do not want any raw SSNs sent to vendor systems; if those exist they are redacted before sending.

- Retention: retention for audit/artifacts is: 7 years for payroll-related records, 3 years for customer support transcripts. For embeddings derived from user content, we require explicit opt-in before persistent storage.

- Support access: we only allow 2 support roles to have break-glass: Support Lead and Security Ops. Break-glass must be approved by Security Ops and logged with reason. Day-to-day support (Tier 1/2) can have read-limited access to metadata for debugging but not to raw PII.

- Logging: we require audit logs to be sent to our S3 bucket (SSE-KMS with our key) and retained per our policy.

I'll attach the Blackridge requirements doc we referenced (Blackridge-Reqs-2027.pdf). Also, please include a redacted SOC2 summary and the RBAC matrix in your package.

Alicia Gomez
Head of Security Programs, Blackridge Systems
alicia@blackridge.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Blackridge requirements — proposed answers + owners

Folks — forwarding Alicia's note. Key asks (summarized) and suggested owners: 

- EU residency (eu-central-1) for prod and backups; no replicas outside EU. [Owner: Marissa]
- PII scope (name, email, payroll_id, VAT). Explicit opt-in required for persistent embeddings. [Owner: Marissa]
- Retention windows: 7y payroll, 3y transcripts; must reflect in retention policy export. [Owner: Ben]
- Support access: only Support Lead + Security Ops get break-glass; Tier1/2 read-limited. Need JIT flow + approval + audit log export to customer's S3 with SSE-KMS. [Owner: Ben]

Proposed implementation notes (draft):
- Residency: provision dedicated EU-only tenancy for the Blackridge tenant; storage AES-256 at rest in eu-central-1; backups in same region. Confirmed no cross-region failover unless explicitly authorized.
- RBAC: provide three role templates: Support_ReadLimited, Support_Debug_JIT, Support_BreakGlass. BreakGlass requires Security Ops approval via an approver API (or on-call approval) and creates an immediate, immutable audit event with user, reason, approver, and TTL.
- JIT: OIDC-based short-lived access token (max 1 hour); tokens minted only after approver action and tied to a single session id.
- Logs: stream audit events to Blackridge S3 with envelope encryption using customer-provided KMS key (supporting cross-account access).

Attachments: I put together a quick RBAC matrix draft (RBAC-matrix-Blackridge-draft.xlsx) to show role mappings and example entitlements. Ben — can you validate the audit export flow / S3 plus KMS compatibility and estimate effort? Marissa — can you confirm we can guarantee EU-only persistence and supply a short architecture diagram?

If we agree on owners, I'll send the formal package to Alicia (SOC2 summary, RBAC matrix, break-glass runbook) and propose a 30-minute walkthrough next week.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Alicia / Security team — thanks for the detailed notes. Confirming next steps and timeline from Redwood: 

1) Package (deliver by EOD Thursday 2027-07-01):
   - Redacted SOC2 summary + controls mapping (SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf)
   - RBAC matrix (RBAC-matrix-Blackridge-draft.xlsx)
   - Break-glass runbook doc + approval flow diagram (link below)

2) Technical commitments:
   - EU-only tenancy + backups in eu-central-1. No cross-region replicas without written approval.
   - Audit event stream to your S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using your key; sample manifest and IAM cross-account policy included in the package.
   - JIT flow: OIDC short-lived tokens (1 hour), approver workflow enforced, immutable audit event on approval.
   - Embeddings persisted only with explicit opt-in flag from your side.

3) Proposed next call: 2027-07-06 09:00 CEST / 00:00 PDT — 30 minutes to review the break-glass runbook and simulate a run. Please confirm if that slot works or propose alternatives.

Links: Drive doc (RBAC & runbook): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Blackridge-Discovery 
HubSpot ticket: 12345

Please confirm the two named break-glass approvers (Support Lead and Security Ops contact) and the list of Tier1/2 support personas who need read-limited metadata access. Once confirmed we'll send the full package and a calendar invite for the walkthrough.

Best,
